user.title: aikos
user.description: Set up aikos. Quiet hours and the other settings are then on the "aikos" device.

init.title: aikos: settings
init.description: Ring push: a push "Someone rang the doorbell" goes to these phones when quiet hours are active or none of the residents is home (at most one per 30 s). Leave a field empty to turn it off. Call archive: for developers, every call as JSON lines.

data_description.doorbell: The doorbell's event (or a binary sensor that turns on when pressed).
data_description.residents: Nobody home = none of these persons is home.
data_description.notify_targets: Where the push goes, e.g. the mobile app service mobile_app_<phone>.
data_description.call_archive: Every call (start with firmware versions, every message, end) as JSON lines in aikos_archive/calls.jsonl in the configuration folder. Stays until you delete it.
data_description.front_door: The door contact the devices follow (opening the front door ends a call). aikos debounces it by 2 s.
data_description.tts_engine: Reads notes and the greeting at the door in the residents' own voices. Use a local service (e.g. aikos TTS through Wyoming). Empty = text is only shown.

door_messages.name: Door messages
door_messages.description: All messages left at the door, newest first (file, time, seconds, recipient, recognised text, speaker, who heard it).

door_message_delete.name: Delete door message
door_message_delete.description: Deletes a door message and its sound file for good.

id.name: Message
id.description: The message's id (its file name without .mp3).

door_message_heard.name: Door message heard
door_message_heard.description: Notes that a resident has heard the message.

id.name: Message
id.description: The message's id (its file name without .mp3).

bell_mute.name: Mute the bell
bell_mute.description: No ring in the house for a while (the phones still get the ring push).

until_time.name: Until
until_time.description: Muted until this time of day (the next one).

quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Switch quiet hours on or off and set start and end.

door_say.name: Note to the door
door_say.description: Shown at the door now if someone is there, else for the next visitor.

sender.name: From
sender.description: Who sends it (shown at the door).

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: The sender's voice at the voice service; empty = shown only.

door_say_cancel.name: Withdraw the note
door_say_cancel.description: The waiting note is not shown.

door_picture.name: Door picture
door_picture.description: A picture for the door's welcome page (grey, until removed).

door_picture_clear.name: Remove the door picture
door_picture_clear.description: No picture at the door any more.

door_greeting.name: Greeting
door_greeting.description: Text and/or a recorded sound for everyone who comes, within a time window, once per visit.

text.name: Text
text.description: At most 120 characters, shown at the door.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: The sender's voice at the voice service; empty = shown only.
